title: Agent Replay: record, replay and regression-gate AI agent trajectories
summary: Python/FastAPI service and CLI that ingests agent runs as OpenTelemetry GenAI spans, stores them in PostgreSQL, replays them deterministically with recorded tool responses, diffs trajectories to the first divergence, scores them with layered checks (deterministic, invariants, optional LLM judge) and gates CI on success rate, step/cost regressions and unsafe actions.
